version: t2-past-1 v1, 8 November 2026, written by the key writer before any past-week run; window 26 October to 1 November 2026
notes: Scanned 8 November 2026 (Master Builders and HIA newsrooms, ABS releases, web search). Out of window and not stories: Cotality October Home Value Index (page metadata 2 November), ABS September building approvals (2 November), the trust tax Senate hearing (early November), the RBA decision (3 November).

stories.what: ABS Consumer Price Index for September 2026, released 28 October 2026: CPI up 4.3% over the year; new dwelling prices up 4.7% over the year (5.4% to August), flat in the month, with builders using discounts as demand slows. Echoed by Master Builders and many outlets: one story.

evidence.quote: New dwelling prices rose 4.7% in the 12 months to September 2026, down from a 5.4% rise to August 2026.

stories.what: ABS Producer Price Indexes for the September quarter 2026, released 30 October 2026: input costs for house construction up 1.0% in the quarter and 3.9% over the year, the fastest annual rise in three years. Echoed by Master Builders and outlets: one story.

evidence.quote: In the 12 months to September, input costs for house construction increased by 3.9 per cent.

stories.what: HIA Affordability Report for the September quarter 2026, released 28 October 2026: the index improved 3.6% as dwelling prices fell, but affordability is still 5.4% worse than a year earlier.

evidence.quote: The HIA Affordability Index increased by 3.6 per cent in the September quarter 2026, reflecting improved affordability across most markets.
evidence.page_date_source: page text (Wednesday 28 October 2026); the page metadata says 2026-10-27, also in the window

stale.what: Queensland Infrastructure Activation Fund ($2.4 billion) opens to applications (19 October 2026).
HIA Housing 100 report for 2025/26 (21 October 2026): largest builders completed 70,553 homes, 35% of the market.
Master Builders opposes the Secure Australian Jobs Framework and Supplier Code changes (22 October 2026).
HIA new home sales slump and 2025/26 commencements (16 October 2026).
Master Builders construction forecasts marked down (1 October 2026).
Trust tax legislation introduced; Master Builders says it fails the sector's concerns (14 October 2026).
ABS Labour Force for September 2026 (15 October): unemployment rate up to 4.7%; construction workforce shortfall projection.
Joint ministerial meeting on housing supply and affordability communique (16 October 2026): record 248,733 homes under construction.
ABS building approvals for August 2026 (dwelling approvals up 10.3% over the year), re-reported by a trade outlet on 30 October 2026.
